synopsis: AGX Terrain is identified as a terrain and soil simulation offering within the commercial Algoryx AGX Dynamics suite [f8354, f8569]. Its stated capabilities include soil deformation with wheels, tracks, blades and buckets, plus terrain paging [f8569]. The glossary also lists AGX Terrain alongside AGX Granular and Mevea’s soil simulation, consistent with Chapter 11’s tool inventory [f15990, f8354]. The supplied facts establish its placement and capabilities but provide no cost figures or validation-performance results [f8354, f15990, f8569].

relations.note: Both identify AGX Terrain among terrain and soil simulation offerings.
Specifies AGX Terrain’s soil-deformation capabilities and terrain paging.
